empty.title: Your backlog is empty
empty.description: Add the games you own, and what you're playing stays at the top.

waiting.title: Nothing waiting
waiting.description: Games you mean to play, but haven't started.

playing.title: Nothing in progress
playing.description: Games you're in the middle of.

completed.title: Nothing finished yet
completed.description: Games you saw all the way through.

abandoned.title: Nothing abandoned
abandoned.description: Games you gave up on. No judgement.

backlog.slotsFull: All spots full — finish a game to free one

game.removeMessage: Its status and rating will be lost.

explore.emptyDescription: The catalogue is still syncing. Check back shortly.

search.promptDescription: Type a title. Two characters is enough to start.

share.title: Shared
share.question: Which game is this?
share.searching: Working out which game this is
share.noLinkDescription: Barklog needs a web link. Share the page itself rather than a screenshot of it.
share.unreadableDescription: Barklog could not open what was shared. Try sharing the video again.
share.unavailableNotice: We couldn't tell which game this is, so these are matches for the title instead.
share.noMatchNone: We couldn't tell which game this is, even after searching the web. Open the original page to check.
share.noMatchUnknown: We couldn't tell which game this is about.
share.noMatchGuesses: We think this is about {{guesses}}, but it isn't in the catalogue yet.

onboarding.welcomeDescription: Barklog holds the games you're playing and the ones you keep meaning to start.
onboarding.backlogDescription: Add a game, then mark it waiting, playing, completed, or abandoned. Abandoned is a real answer.
onboarding.exploreDescription: See what's popular, what's coming out, and what just landed. Or search by name if you already know what you want.
onboarding.shareTitle: Share a video, pick the game
onboarding.shareDescription: Share a YouTube or TikTok video and pick the game — Barklog fetches the candidates for you.
onboarding.igdbTitle: All game data is powered by IGDB
onboarding.igdbDescription: Every cover, release date, platform, and summary in Barklog comes from IGDB, a games database its community maintains.

errors.offlineDescription: Barklog could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.rateLimitedDescription: You've made a lot of requests. Try again shortly.
errors.serverDescription: The server couldn't answer. Try again in a moment.

unauthorized.title: You're signed out
unauthorized.description: Sign in again to keep going.

game_not_found.title: Game not found
game_not_found.description: That game isn't in the catalogue.

backlog_entry_not_found.title: Not in your backlog
backlog_entry_not_found.description: That game isn't in your backlog any more.

backlog_cap_reached.title: Your backlog is full
backlog_cap_reached.description_one: Finish a game to free a spot, or go Premium.
backlog_cap_reached.description_other: Finish {{count}} games to free a spot, or go Premium.

share_invalid_url.title: Can't open that link
share_invalid_url.description: Barklog needs an https web address.

share_source_gone.title: That page is gone
share_source_gone.description: It may be private or removed.

share_source_blocked.title: That site said no
share_source_blocked.description: It would not let us read the page.

share_source_unreadable.title: Nothing to read there
share_source_unreadable.description: We opened that link but could not find a title on it.

share_fetch_failed.title: Couldn't read that link
share_fetch_failed.description: That link could not be read right now. Try again shortly.
